name: Avoid proprietary software
description: The adversary is avoiding proprietary software because of possible backdoors, spyware, and surveillance.

subtechniques.name: Alternative app store
subtechniques.description: Alternative app stores are used to be able to install more privacy and anonymity focused applications on mobile phones.

procedures.name: Fdroid
procedures.description: F-Droid is an installable catalogue of free and open source software applications for the Android platform. https://f-droid.org/

procedures.name: Aurora Store
procedures.description: Aurora Store is a free Google Play Store alternative where one can download apps, update the apps you already have, receive details about in-app trackers, hide your location, search for apps, and so on.

subtechniques.name: Closed source apps for public use
subtechniques.description: Closed source apps should only be used for public use (non-anonymous) on segmented profiles.

subtechniques.name: Closed-source OS only in VM
subtechniques.description: Closed-source operating systems might only be run in virtual machines to prevent leaking information to third parties, such as with telemetry. With VMs there is more control over network traffic.

procedures.name: Flowblade
procedures.description: Flowblade is a multitrack non-linear video editor that supports all the media that can be accessed in a Linux system. https://jliljebl.github.io/flowblade/

procedures.name: Audacity
procedures.description: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder. Audacity is free and open source. https://www.audacityteam.org/download/

procedures.name: Ristretto
procedures.description: Ristretto is an image viewer for the Xfce desktop environment. https://github.com/xfce-mirror/ristretto

procedures.name: Rumble
procedures.description: Rumble is an online video platform. https://rumble.com/
